module_summary: UDP frame demultiplexer: latches select/drop at header acceptance, registers the header to the chosen output's valid bit, and steers payload through a skid buffer to one of M outputs.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Idle/in-frame state: set on header accept, cleared on payload tlast

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Latched output port select steering header valid and payload tvalid

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; starts a frame when idle

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready when idle, no pending output header, enabled

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input UDP payload stream data

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid, shifted to selected output tvalid

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready during frame when output ready or dropping

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-output header valid, one-hot by select unless dropped

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload data broadcast to all outputs from output register

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-output payload ready controlling skid buffer

anchors.name: drop_reg
anchors.why: Frame drop flag suppressing output valids while consuming input

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: Output port select sampled at frame start

anchors.name: drop
anchors.why: Drop request sampled at frame start

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Gates header and payload ready

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-output header ready clearing header valid

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload, ends frame and clears drop

anchors.name: select_ctl
anchors.why: Effective select this cycle, bypassing register at frame start

anchors.name: drop_ctl
anchors.why: Effective drop this cycle gating payload valid and ready

anchors.name: s_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Representative input header field captured at frame start

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Representative registered header field replicated to all outputs

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready choosing output vs temp storage

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready when output accepting or both skid registers empty

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data when output stalled

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp skid entry occupied, per output

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads input beat directly into output register

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads input beat into temp register

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp beat into output register

groups.name: Frame control
groups.description: Tracks frame, latches select/drop at header accept, generates input readies

groups.name: Header register
groups.description: Registers UDP/IP/Ethernet header fields, replicated to outputs with one-hot valid

groups.name: Payload input steering
groups.description: Accepts payload stream and shifts valid to selected output

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving per-output payload streams
